lines: Evasion rating grants a chance to avoid a hit completely, including its damage, stagger, knockback and ailment. The chance weighs evasion rating against the attacker's accuracy and reaches 100% at 3 times the accuracy. Each evasion against the same attacker leaves 80% of the chance against it, until it lands no attack for 8 (30 for a boss). Each evasion costs 18% of maximum stamina; without that stamina the hit lands. Damage over time, persistent damaging ground and environmental damage cannot be evaded; a successful passive evasion triggers on evade, independently of a manual dodge roll. Passive evasions interrupt stamina regeneration unless an effect explicitly prevents this.
new.name: Evasion rating

lines: 15% increased area of effect on primary attack hit recently

Ground Strike: Heavy melee weapons replace their alternative attack with a ground slam that deals only blunt damage; Base slam radius for weapons without an area attack: 3 m; Heavy melee weapons replace their alternative attack with a ground slam that deals only blunt damage, without the leap.
Fault Line: Slams cover a line with a base width of 1.4 m instead of a circle, preserving total area; Your slams hit a narrow line ahead of you instead of a circle, covering the same area.

Raise the Earth: Slamming your created object consumes it and raises an impassable ridge for 4 s; Base ridge length: 3.5 m; ×0.7 area with the slam that raises the ridge; Slamming one of your own created objects consumes it and leaves a brief impassable ridge. That slam's area is smaller. Buildings are not damaged.
